purpose: Stress S1 with a compute- and HBM-intensive real LLM prefill and determine whether an MPS SM cap can protect the paired full-PHY RAN.

qualification_gate.selection_rule: Among configurations passing both RAN gates in both runs, choose the highest mean Qwen throughput. If none passes, S1 rejects this workload and S0 requires smaller preemptible chunks or a longer period.

interpretation_limit: The test is statistical and MPS caps still do not provide a memory-bandwidth bound.
